conditional_findings.first_contract: Scene weather validation should reject or safely compare every representable decoded temperature without overflowing before returning its typed validation result.
conditional_findings.classification: New current source assessment of an existing original059 pending question; original historic width description is corrected rather than rewritten, with no historical unique-count increment.
conditional_findings.trace: WeatherSnapshot and AtmosphericSnapshot derive Deserialize and expose temperature_deci_c and dew_point_deci_c as i32. In the weather validator, after earlier rules-version and basis-point checks, the expression dew_point_deci_c > temperature_deci_c + 5 adds in i32 without a preceding temperature range check in that function. Consider an otherwise valid scene and WeatherSnapshot defaults except temperature_deci_c=i32::MAX: preceding weather predicates are false and dew point is0. Mathematically i32::MAX+5 exceeds i32::MAX by5. If the selected Rust build enables integer overflow checks, the addition panics before the typed Weather error can be returned. If checks are disabled and the addition wraps, the value becomes −2147483644 and 0 compares greater, so this particular example is rejected with Weather rather than safely compared. This is source and integer reasoning; no scene, decoder, validation, build or product ran.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The whole-scene example assumes every earlier source and grounding check needed to reach weather validation succeeds; no complete scene input, serialized file, server startup, actual producer, profile or panic behavior was executed or observed. The selected startup loads a scene and maps normal load errors, but whether this extreme value occurs or any unwinding is caught is unknown. Normal generated weather may impose tighter practical ranges, and a semantic policy may reject such an extreme: that does not alone establish safe validation arithmetic. The historical059 queue description says raw i16 temperature; exact frozen6533 source and byte-identical95e WeatherSnapshot declare i32. The historical statement remains untouched and is corrected in this current record. The native file-size metadata/read race is a separate unresolved part of the same queue entry.
